parent_objective: run a no-training quota-calibrated source-balanced temporal wave

public_gates: selected_pair_count reaches the registered target or failure cause is recorded
source-balance metrics pass or are classified
temporal action and outcome rows are reported separately
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not lower M727 thresholds after seeing M728 output
do not treat action-only rows as outcome proof
do not add hidden fault labels or oracle values to actor observations

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether removing the M725 step-bucket cap artifact yields a clean source-balanced temporal wave
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic data wave only; no policy update or promotion
stop_condition: stop if source-balance quotas still fail
stop if sentinel false positives exceed threshold
stop if outcome rows remain zero after source-balanced pass and audit before another miner
stop if actor checksum or input contract changes
fallback_plan: if source balance passes but outcome remains zero, audit for boundary mining sequence intervention or dynamics fidelity
if source balance fails, audit selected/proposal distribution before changing scenarios
if outcome rows appear, audit and export compact corpus before objective design

hypothesis: Removing the M725 per-step-bucket cap artifact can produce a full source-balanced 4096-pair temporal wave without changing actor inputs or training.
success_criteria: M728 runs the registered quota-calibrated command
M728 reports source-balance temporal action outcome and sentinel metrics
M728 keeps action and outcome evidence separate
no training PPO actor update or promotion occurs
failure_criteria: runner selects fewer than target pairs without classified quota evidence
runner combines action-only and outcome-positive claims
runner starts optimizer training PPO or checkpoint promotion

commands.name: registered_run
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.source_balanced_temporal_wave --checkpoint runs/m568_scaled_l3_bc_seed5660/checkpoint.pt --config configs/extreme_fault_coverage_v2_scenarios.json --seed-start 72000 --seed-count 512 --selected-pair-count 4096 --per-seed-pair-cap 8 --per-fault-family-pair-cap 256 --per-preferred-family-cap 640 --per-step-bucket-cap 4096 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m728_quota_calibrated_source_balanced_temporal_wave

decision_rule: M728 may only classify the no-training quota-calibrated wave. It must not admit source export objective design actor update PPO or promotion until an audit reviews the result.
